findings.evidence: TR-9, US4.5: the migrate command never names its failure code. src/Iskender.ControlPlane.Host/Program.cs drops MigrationOutcome.Code, event 7006 has no code field, and no other event names persistence.unavailable or persistence.migration_locked (T039, T046 results). Gap type partial. T049.

FR-012, TR-10, TR-14: a configuration that module settings reject at host start (CoordinationSettings redis username/password outside development, leases.maximumDuration; PostgreSqlSettings poolMinimum above poolMaximum) escapes app.StartAsync in src/Iskender.Infrastructure.Container/ContainerEntryPoint.cs as exit 1 with 7005 naming GatewayException and no code, where equal ports exits 2 with 7002 (T034 note). Gap type partial. T050.

Container contract Telemetry rule 2, FR-028: the other standard OTEL_* variables do not configure the OTLP exporter, because CreateEmptyBuilder leaves the SDK IConfiguration empty and ContainerTelemetry passes only the endpoint (T028 open note). Gap type partial. T051.

Container contract Migration command rule 5, Diagnostics rules 4 and 6: ContainerEntryPoint.RunAsync awaits a definition command with no catch, and MigrationCommand rethrows any non-persistence failure, so such a migrate run writes no 7006 and ends with the runtime unhandled-exception trace, message included, on standard error. Gap type partial. T052.

SC-001, tasks note No fixed sleeps (a real flake is a blocker): the intermittent CoordinationReasonTests authentication_failed failure recorded in T025 is still open and its cause unknown. Gap type partial. T053.
